game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by ash wraiths.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Print every even number from 20 through 38. Trace the update by 2 and the final failed condition. Test dataset 5: {}; {}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp: keep the power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Comparison Duel – Cinder Cone Camp Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
